title: Unity Catalog Permission and Role Change Audit
app: Unity Catalog audit logs via cloud storage / HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=unity_catalog:audit (action_name="updatePermissions" OR action_name="createShare" OR action_name="updateSharePermissions")
| stats count as changes, values(action) as actions by user_identity.email
| sort - changes
description: Audits Unity Catalog events that grant, revoke or modify permissions and roles, giving a change trail for least-privilege reviews and incident investigation.
value: Unreviewed permission changes are a leading cause of data-access incidents; an audit trail for Unity Catalog supports governance and rollback.
implementation: Ingest Unity Catalog admin/audit events; schedule daily and alert on privilege grants made outside an approved change window.
visualization: Table of actor by change count with actions, timeline.
grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who changes access and permissions in Unity Catalog so unexpected changes can be traced.
